simple.meaning: עֵיבָל (ʻÊybâl) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Genesis 36:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, altar, covenant, priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵיבָל (H5858) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עֵיבָל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עֵיבָל (ʻÊybâl) / H5858 is tracked through Genesis 36:23, Deuteronomy 11:29, Deuteronomy 27:4, Deuteronomy 27:13. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.
It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
Then Joshua built an altar to Yahweh, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,

All Israel, with their elders, officers, and judges, stood on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests, who carried the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, the foreigner as well as the native; half of them in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of Yahweh had commanded at the first, that they should bless the people of Israel.
The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
